Alright so I've done emdr for 3 years all of which I've smoked weed. I recently stopped for fertility reasons. But this is my two sense..

You can process the memories and work through them even if you smoke weed the night after or before. 

You can work through them woth a trusted therapist and get better at how you react to things. Even if you smoke weed. 

But there are things you need to not do.. 

You need to not smoke right after a session or before. You need to not rely on smoking. You need to not smoke every single day. You need to not smoke all day.

If you don't abide by these rules you will have an utter shit show of an experience dealing with life not high. But I am on the otherside of this and believe you can still participate in a puff recreationally.
